Primary Pd porphyrin structural study and explicit comparison to PdII(TPP) with Pd-N about 2.009 A. Family electronic assignment; input Pd-N about 2.039 A and complete TPP witness.
Primary experimental SI section1.2.1 describes AuIII tetrakis(pentafluorophenyl)porphyrin; molecular cation formula C44H8AuF20N4+ agrees with complete input.

Primary synthesis of ZnII porphyrins with 3,5-difluorophenyl substituents. Different fourth substituent, family evidence only; target full graph independently verified.
Original thesis synthesis and characterization of ZnII meso tetra(4-bromophenyl)porphyrin, compound75; same composition, no target crystal mapping.
